- docs/INVENTORY.md: lines 267-270 (the entry block added by the last run, between `run_plan_codex.sh` at 267 and `run_validation_repo_checks.sh` at 270) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The last run inserted `sandbox_image.sh` (268) and `sandbox_images_publish.sh` (269) between `run_plan_codex.sh` (267) and `run_validation_repo_checks.sh` (270), breaking the strict alphabetical ordering convention that every other Scripts entry in the section follows (e.g. 264 review_untrusted_sandbox.sh, 265 review_untrusted_workspace.py, 266 reviewer_failback_chains.json, 267 run_plan_codex.sh, 270 run_validation_repo_checks.sh, 271 run_workspace_hook.sh, 272 self_heal_validation.sh). The correct ordering is run_plan_codex.sh → run_validation_repo_checks.sh → run_workspace_hook.sh → sandbox_image.sh → sandbox_images_publish.sh → self_heal_validation.sh.
  WHY: This is an organisational defect rather than a runtime failure, but `docs/INVENTORY.md` is the authoritative Phase B drift-control inventory and downstream tools that regenerate the list (e.g. `tests/inventory_parity.py`) and human readers expect alphabetical order. The two adjacent entries that violate the convention (`run_validation_repo_checks.sh`, `run_workspace_hook.sh`, `self_heal_validation.sh`) become harder to find in maintenance.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR DESCRIPTION (part 3, second bullet) adds `SANDBOX_IMAGE` as a stable log prefix and the agents.md prefix table registers the new entry (line 2081). The agents.md contract requires the human-readable prefix table and the `LOG_PREFIX.name=…` registry at the bottom of the same file to be kept in lockstep — the convention is enforced by tests such as `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:3099` (`test_fingerprint_cap_log_prefixes_are_registered`), which asserts both `- \`PREFIX\`` and `LOG_PREFIX.name=PREFIX` exist for every stable prefix.
  Expected change site: agents.md, `LOG_PREFIX.name=…` registry block (alongside the other `LOG_PREFIX.name=…` entries around line 2300-2517, e.g. after `LOG_PREFIX.name=CLAUDE_POOL_HEALTH` at line 2327 to keep alphabetical lockstep with the prefix list above).
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds `- \`SANDBOX_IMAGE\` (scripts/sandbox_image.sh: family= outcome=pulled|built|published|publish_skipped reason= ref=)` at agents.md:2081, but no corresponding `LOG_PREFIX.name=SANDBOX_IMAGE` line exists anywhere in agents.md (`grep -n 'LOG_PREFIX\.name=SANDBOX' agents.md` returns zero matches). The last run only added the new workflow to the `<!-- TREE:START id=workflows -->` block at line 2829; it did not add the missing registry entry, and the original PR also never added it. Any tool that walks the `LOG_PREFIX.name=…` registry to validate emitted log prefixes (the workflow-log-analysis tooling and the registry-enforcement tests) would miss `SANDBOX_IMAGE`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
